policy: API families are assigned from exact imported symbol names; they do not assert execution order or runtime behavior.
A nearby code-address relocation is not by itself proof that the target is an argument to the adjacent API.
A data relocation is reported only with its owning ELF object and exact target function when both are resolvable.
No field layout, register meaning, firmware lifetime, IRQ teardown safety, or callback prototype is inferred here.
All unresolved callback source, target, ABI, and ownership questions remain blockers for H1/H4 and candidate source work.
known_open_questions: The 0x7cc2eb16 callsite signature and source chain are corroborated to i2c_algorithm.functionality; the concrete implementation is selected by the runtime adapter, while other indirect pointer origins remain to be traced.
Callback assignment and argument dataflow must be reviewed against the exact assembly and relocations before source reconstruction.
Teardown order and completion ownership require a per-object state/lifetime proof, not only API-name matching.
